QB.name: Matthew Stafford
QB.injury: Nov 2: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

QB.name: Kyler Murray
QB.injury: Nov 2: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray has a sore hamstring and will undergo a full evaluation as the Vikings look to determine the extent of the issue, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

QB.name: Jaxson Dart
QB.injury: Sep 30: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

QB.name: Jalen Hurts
QB.injury: Oct 19: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

QB.name: Lamar Jackson
QB.injury: Nov 1: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

QB.name: Drew Lock
QB.injury: Nov 2: Lock (coach's decision) is inactive for Monday's matchup with the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

RB.name: Breece Hall
RB.injury: Nov 2: Hall (quadriceps) is considered "good to go" and is expected to return to action in next Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: Bhayshul Tuten
RB.injury: Nov 2: Tuten was a non-participant at Monday's walkthrough due to ankle and foot injuries.

RB.name: Cam Skattebo
RB.injury: Nov 2: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said that Skattebo (hamstring) is day-to-day and could end up being a game-time decision for Sunday's tilt with the Eagles, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: David Montgomery
RB.injury: Nov 2: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

RB.name: Travis Etienne
RB.injury: Nov 2: Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

RB.name: De'Von Achane
RB.injury: Sep 28: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

RB.name: Christian McCaffrey
RB.injury: Oct 26: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

RB.name: RJ Harvey
RB.injury: Oct 31: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
RB.injury: Oct 19: The Commanders placed Croskey-Merritt (groin) on injured reserve Monday.

RB.name: Jeremiyah Love
RB.injury: Nov 2: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love suffered a "new" ankle injury during Sunday's overtime win at Dallas, and that he'll have an update on the running back later this week, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: Chris Rodriguez
RB.injury: Nov 2: Rodriguez was listed as limited on Monday's practice estimate due to a hand injury.

RB.name: Tyrone Tracy
RB.injury: Oct 27: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

WR.name: DJ Moore
WR.injury: Nov 1: Moore indicated following Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens that he's okay in the wake of his late-game exit due to a knee issue, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

WR.name: Christian Watson
WR.injury: Nov 2: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Terry McLaurin
WR.injury: Oct 30: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Mike Evans
WR.injury: Oct 26: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

WR.name: Deebo Samuel
WR.injury: Oct 26: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

WR.name: Alec Pierce
WR.injury: Oct 26: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

WR.name: AJ Brown
WR.injury: Nov 2: When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday, "We'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

WR.name: Michael Pittman
WR.injury: Nov 2: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

WR.name: Davante Adams
WR.injury: Oct 28: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

WR.name: Romeo Doubs
WR.injury: Oct 19: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

WR.name: Jayden Reed
WR.injury: Sep 30: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

WR.name: Jakobi Meyers
WR.injury: Nov 2: Meyers logged two catches for 24 yards on three targets in Sunday's 42-7 win against Indianapolis.

WR.name: Kendrick Bourne
WR.injury: Nov 2: Bourne (ankle) is expected to miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Michael Wilson
WR.injury: Nov 1: Wilson said after Sunday's 33-30 win at Dallas that he suffered two broken ribs during the contest, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

WR.name: Jalen Brooks
WR.injury: Oct 27: The Cardinals placed Brooks (wrist) on injured reserve Tuesday.

WR.name: Jaylin Noel
WR.injury: Oct 28: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

TE.name: Hunter Henry
TE.injury: Nov 3: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back to help us."

TE.name: Jake Ferguson
TE.injury: Nov 2: Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Ferguson (ankle) has a chance to play Sunday at Indianapolis, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

TE.name: Cole Kmet
TE.injury: Oct 23: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.
